scenes.headline:
You know the book.
And you still retype it
card: Knows the cover better than the system does
and still types it in three times
scenes.say: Somewhere right now there is someone who knows general insurance inside out, and still spends the day retyping what the record already holds.

scenes.headline: You retype it. You wait. / And the history is in four places
scenes.say: You retype the proposal form. You wait three days for an endorsement. And the history you are advising on sits in four different places.

scenes.headline: Our own general insurance agency. / Already running
scenes.sub: Chaguanas, Central Trinidad. One client manager.
scenes.say: The branch has opened its own general insurance agency. And it already has a book.

scenes.eyebrow: The book you would look after
scenes.headline: You would not be building one. / It is already there
scenes.line: Renewals in every month of the year. The largest motor policy on it carries sixty-one vehicles.
scenes.say: You would not be building a book. We have one. A hundred and three clients, a hundred and ninety five policies in force, and renewals in every single month of the year.

scenes.headline: Every term since the policy began

check: already on the screen when you open it

scenes.say: Before you open a file, every term since the policy began is already on the screen. What was covered, at what value, what was paid, and the claims that fell in each term.

scenes.headline: Read for you, / and checked against our record

bill.out: The desk says so, before it reaches the client

scenes.say: The insurer's notice is read for you, and every figure is checked against our own record. Where the two disagree, the desk says so.

scenes.headline: The part a system cannot do
cards: what the cover does, and what it does not
The Act, and what changes in it
market conduct, in writing, on the file
the part they remember us for
A record the next person can read
because one day it will not be you
scenes.say: The job is the part a system cannot do. Endorsements and extensions. The renewal conversation. Telling a client plainly what the cover does and what it does not. And knowing when the Act changes.

scenes.eyebrow: The part most people in this work never get
scenes.headline: A change is not a ticket. / It is a decision

script.rhead: Here · the rule, in the desk

scenes.say: Here is the part most people in this work never get. A change you ask for is not a ticket that joins a queue somewhere else. It is written into the desk, and it runs on every file that week.

scenes.eyebrow: Changes you would make in your first month
scenes.headline: Yours, running on every file
cards: with the claims history already on it
it fills from the record, as the quote does
A flag when a sum stops moving
three years unchanged, before the renewal
scenes.say: A renewal that goes out thirty days ahead with the claims history on it. An endorsement nobody types in twice. A flag when the sum insured has not moved in three years.

scenes.headline: The paperwork is finished. / The advice is not

r: not settled — and that is yours
split.line: How this agency looks after its clients is the part we want you for.

scenes.say: The paperwork is finished. The advice is not. That is the job.

scenes.urlsub:
Your CV and fifteen minutes.
Read by the Branch Manager alone.
scenes.say: One seat, for a client manager. Chaguanas. Come and look after the book.
